title: Build audio seek checkpoints from codec state plus filter state together

definition.title: Build audio seek checkpoints from codec state plus filter state together
definition.source_excerpt: Capture versioned logical continuation state across a fixed decoder/resampler/mixer/filter pipeline with exact sample identity. Verify restored output and reject recipe/runtime/source changes rather than persisting raw pointers.
definition.impact_basis: Potentially removes substantial work from an eligible playback, seek, preparation, retention or repeated interaction. Scope comes from the cited card; exposure and effect size are unmeasured.
definition.default_next_action: Trace the precise owner, generation, reset/flush/commit or allocation being changed. Reproduce the present behavior before removing any guard.
definition.minimum_probe: One short action trace through existing code with the candidate disabled/enabled; include the specific seek, cancellation or replacement transition it can affect.
definition.initial_screen: Trace the precise owner, generation, reset/flush/commit or allocation being changed. Reproduce the present behavior before removing any guard. One short action trace through existing code with the candidate disabled/enabled; include the specific seek, cancellation or replacement transition it can affect.
definition.primary_metric: User-visible operation latency, duplicated work or peak/steady live resource ownership; not object counts alone.
definition.scope_contract: Actual output identity and timeline, surviving consumers, committed generations and cleanup; candidate execution must be visible.
definition.negative_control: Cancel or replace a source at the changed boundary and delay a stale callback/consumer; reject late publication and premature reuse.
definition.stop_boundary: At the first need for a cross-backend ownership redesign, record DEFER_SETUP. Do not remove a semantically required reset or increase a timeout to hide a failure.
definition.shared_prerequisite: Relevant existing runtime/owner only. Do not require every other backend to pass before this independent screen.
definition.reopen_condition: A new applicable workload, resolved prerequisite, better independent oracle, or materially different bounded implementation changes the recorded decision.
definition.relevance_basis: Editorial fit to ordinary Demuxe playback goals, not measured prevalence; rerank after one local opportunity audit.

define.basis: Exact full-key mechanism, bounded workload, matched baseline and predeclared threshold.

prepare.basis: Fixtures, source/runtime hashes, independent PCM oracle, adverse and lifecycle controls pinned.

correctness.basis: Actual stereo IMA-WAV logical predictor/index/nibble position state combined with explicit integer stereo average, pair-average2to1 resampler pending phase, and integer IIR state. Whole8136input frames→4068output frames exactly match independent FFmpeg8.1.2 decode followed by ordinary pipeline. Thirty-five128sample seek continuations exact, including13restores with pending odd-input resampler phase, codec block resets and nearEOF. Thirty-two JSON checkpoints18240bytes contain only logical fields/positions plus source/runtime/recipe/epoch identity and checksum, no raw pointers. Omitting filter or pending phase changes output; changed source/runtime/filter/epoch, corrupted snapshot and cancellation reject. Five complete cold read/hash/parse/checkpoint-building/JSONwrite-read plus35seek-output jobs37.634ms versus full-prefix replay171.893ms ratio0.21894 passes<=0.9.

performance.basis: Pursue this exact versioned IMA-WAV/mixer/resampler/IIR recipe and repeated-seek workload. Encoder padding is included explicitly; no gapless trim claim. Current per-shift IMA arithmetic is verified against installedFFmpeg8.1.2; older report/product-rounding rule differs and is preserved as rejected cross-runtime evidence. Other codecs, resamplers, filters, recipe changes and production integration require new logical continuation contracts.

results.basis: New raw measurements and setup costs captured alongside pinned correctness reuse.
